description: Installed memory. Conditioned on the resolved chip: Apple sells each chip in a fixed set of unified-memory capacities, so an M4 Max at 32 GiB (the pre-conditioning draw for seed 42) is a machine that has never existed. Selection is clamped down to host physical memory and never up.
label: memory

options.note: AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. Apple sells this chip only in these capacities, so a value outside this list is a machine that does not exist. navigator.deviceMemory rounds to the nearer power of two and clamps to 8, so every value at or above 8 GiB reports 8; these figures are chip-exact so the profile describes a real machine, not because deviceMemory can tell them apart. Nothing below 8 GiB is offered: patch 0087 feeds this figure into V8's heap sizing, so a low value costs real page reliability.
